scope: Local server-backed demo; live launch blocked

items.requirement: Homepage loads without blank screens or crashes
items.evidence: Browser A/D/H/I/J: homepage renders server HTML and hydrates; API/product content loads.

items.requirement: Logo, navigation, banners and product images render correctly
items.evidence: Browser A/D/H/I/J: logo/navigation and every visible image checked for natural dimensions.

items.requirement: No console errors or failed critical network requests
items.evidence: Browser A/D/H/I/J: pageerror and failed-request listeners are empty on normal loads.

items.requirement: App promotion strip displays correctly and can be dismissed
items.evidence: Dismissible store-promotion strip persists after refresh. No verified Jai Hind app/listing/download count exists; app-download claims are withheld.

items.requirement: Refresh and direct URL visits work without errors
items.evidence: Browser A/B, C/F, E/I/J/S and checkout/order tests cover refresh and direct product/collection/account/order URLs.

items.requirement: Hero images are sharp and correctly cropped on all screens
items.evidence: Desktop/mobile captures and all viewport tests review object-fit crops; responsive local WebP candidates.

items.requirement: Every promotional CTA navigates to its intended destination
items.evidence: Hero CTA and category/collection CTAs resolve to the intended collection; directions use the verified Place ID.

items.requirement: Carousel controls, swipe gestures and indicators work
items.evidence: Browser A/B tests previous/next buttons, indicators and pointer-based swipe changes.

items.requirement: Sale claims, discount percentages and offer dates are accurate
items.evidence: Demo prices/MRP and WELCOME10 dates/conditions agree with the server fixtures; actual merchant offer approval is outstanding.

items.requirement: No text overlaps or clipped promotional content
items.evidence: Viewport/reflow checks and screenshot review show promotional text without horizontal overflow.

items.requirement: Women, Men, Kids and other category links work
items.evidence: Browser C/F visits Women/Men/Kids and fallback; Men/Kids honestly show no available inventory.

items.requirement: Category images and labels match their destination
items.evidence: Collection labels and buttons use matching filters; category tabs resolve to their own routes.

items.requirement: Product listings show the correct category
items.evidence: Eight demo Women products match their category; no invented Men/Kids products. Real catalogue still required.

items.requirement: Filters and sorting update results correctly
items.evidence: Browser C/F verifies combined collection/colour/price filters and all four sort modes.

items.requirement: Empty collections show a useful fallback
items.evidence: Unavailable categories and zero matches show a useful explanation and reset/explore CTA.

items.requirement: Poppins is applied consistently, including after font loading
items.evidence: Browser font-family assertion and self-hosted latin Poppins 400/500/600/700, including editorial emphasis.

items.requirement: Deep blue, white and yellow match the design system
items.evidence: White #fff, primary blue #153f73 and yellow #f9d65b match the supplied brief. Exact external design-system comparison blocked by inaccessible reference.

items.requirement: Buttons, spacing, radii and typography are consistent
items.evidence: Common button/form/dialog styles and responsive screenshot review; shared spacing/type tokens.

items.requirement: Hover, focus, active, loading and disabled states are polished
items.evidence: Disabled out-of-stock options, focus-visible outlines, hover states, skeletons, busy controls and error recovery reviewed.

items.requirement: No layout shifts, stretched photos or overlapping components
items.evidence: Viewport/long-name/reflow checks; lab CLS 0.011 mobile and 0.004 desktop; no stretched images in captures.

items.requirement: Product cards show correct names, images and prices
items.evidence: API catalog assertions and browser product cards match sample names/photos/paise prices; merchant catalogue not supplied.

items.requirement: Product detail pages open for every active item
items.evidence: Browser E/I/J/S opens all eight active product routes and missing-product fallback.

items.requirement: Size, colour and variant selection work correctly
items.evidence: Free-size standard variant works; each product has its labelled colour and unavailable premium variant. Real variants require merchant data.

items.requirement: Unavailable variants cannot be purchased
items.evidence: Native disabled property is asserted; API rejects zero-stock/unknown variants regardless of client state.

items.requirement: Add to Cart and Buy Now perform the correct actions
items.evidence: Add-to-cart changes the saved bag; Buy Now navigates with the selected variant to checkout.

items.requirement: Price, size, colour and category filters work
items.evidence: Price, category, size and colour filter controls implemented; combined collection/colour/size/minimum/maximum-price browser checks and empty state.

items.requirement: Multiple filters can be combined and cleared
items.evidence: Browser C/F combines filters, checks one/zero matches, then clears to eight styles.

items.requirement: Sorting by price, newest and popularity is correct
items.evidence: Ascending/descending price, newest and popularity each assert the expected first product.

items.requirement: Result counts update after filtering
items.evidence: Live result counts assert eight/one/zero and update with route filters.

items.requirement: Filters remain usable on mobile
items.evidence: Android/WebKit projects open mobile filters and use collection/colour/price/sort controls.

items.requirement: Header links and logo navigate correctly
items.evidence: Logo returns home; header collection/account/store links and direct routes reviewed.

items.requirement: Search, account, wishlist and cart icons work
items.evidence: Search, account page, wishlist drawer and bag drawer exercised in browser suites.

items.requirement: Mobile menu opens, closes and navigates correctly
items.evidence: Mobile menu opens/closes, exposes category and account controls, and closes after route navigation.

items.requirement: Dropdown menus work with mouse, touch and keyboard
items.evidence: Hover dropdowns, touch buttons and ArrowDown/Escape keyboard handling checked.

items.requirement: Sticky header does not obscure content
items.evidence: Sticky header and scroll-padding reviewed; product/form controls remain usable after scrolling.

items.requirement: Every section matches the approved visual design
items.evidence: Exact approved visual design is unavailable: gitreverse reference returns proxy 403 and no approved baseline was supplied.

items.requirement: Sections appear in the correct order
items.evidence: Browser section-order assertion and capture review: hero, trust, collections, offer, top picks, editorial, store, newsletter.

items.requirement: Top Picks, sale banners and collection grids populate
items.evidence: Top picks, offer banner and four collection cards populate with labelled demo imagery/prices.

items.requirement: Trust badges and promotional messaging are accurate
items.evidence: Physical-store claims use verified address/hours/Google rating; no unverified app ratings, testimonials or delivery badges.

items.requirement: No duplicate, empty or broken homepage modules
items.evidence: Rendered section/card counts and all-image checks find no broken or accidental empty homepage modules.

items.requirement: All product and lifestyle images load successfully
items.evidence: All images are scrolled into view and checked complete/naturalWidth > 0 in each engine.

items.requirement: Responsive images use appropriate sizes and formats
items.evidence: 320/480/960/original WebP srcsets, correct hero sizes and viewport-before-preload avoid duplicate oversized requests.

items.requirement: Lazy loading works without leaving blank cards
items.evidence: Lazy product/editorial images load as scrolled into view; failure fallback has a working retry button.

items.requirement: Image zoom or galleries work where implemented
items.evidence: Product zoom opens accessible modal and Escape closes it; each product has one honest sample photo.

items.requirement: Meaningful images have appropriate alt text
items.evidence: Browser assertions require meaningful nonempty alt text; decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.

items.requirement: No uncaught JavaScript exceptions
items.evidence: Normal-load browser pageerror collection stays empty; API errors use visible recovery paths.

items.requirement: No hydration warnings or broken interactive components
items.evidence: Server-rendered homepage hydrates without recorded exceptions; carousel/menu/filters/cart remain interactive.

items.requirement: Rapid clicks do not duplicate actions
items.evidence: Rapid add/newsletter/order clicks produce one logical action/request/order; idempotency enforced server-side.

items.requirement: Dialogs, menus and drawers open and close reliably
items.evidence: Repeated modal/drawer open/close and Escape handling checked, with focus returned to trigger.

items.requirement: Back and forward browser navigation work correctly
items.evidence: Browser E/I/J/S exercises back to product and forward to collection, plus direct missing-page fallback.

items.requirement: All actionable elements are keyboard reachable
items.evidence: Keyboard dropdown, modal and form controls exercised; native elements and visible focus states.

items.requirement: Tab order follows the visual layout
items.evidence: Shared dialog focus order and native form sequence reviewed; no positive tabindex hacks.

items.requirement: Focus indicators are visible
items.evidence: Focus-visible outlines retained for buttons/links/inputs/selects; keyboard screenshot/manual review.

items.requirement: Escape closes dialogs and menus where appropriate
items.evidence: Escape closes navigation dropdowns, dialogs, search and filters; explicit close buttons also available.

items.requirement: No keyboard traps occur
items.evidence: Dialogs intentionally contain Tab focus, with Escape/close exits and restored trigger focus; browser G/K checks.

items.requirement: Core Web Vitals are measured on mobile and desktop
items.evidence: Mobile/desktop Lighthouse lab LCP/CLS/TBT measured and consented LCP/INP/CLS collection added. No real-user mobile/desktop cohort exists yet.

items.requirement: LCP target is 2.5 seconds or less at the 75th percentile
items.evidence: p75 LCP needs real deployed traffic. Final mobile lab is 2.38 s and desktop 0.57 s; lab values cannot establish field p75.

items.requirement: INP target is 200 ms or less at the 75th percentile
items.evidence: p75 INP requires real-user interactions. Consent-gated collection exists; Lighthouse TBT is not INP.

items.requirement: CLS target is 0.1 or less at the 75th percentile
items.evidence: p75 CLS requires real deployed traffic. Lab CLS is below 0.1 on both profiles, but no field distribution is available.

items.requirement: Slow connections show usable loading and error states
items.evidence: Delayed API test shows skeleton; interrupted API and image requests expose retry and recover. API timeout is 15 seconds.

items.requirement: Layouts work at 320, 360, 375, 390 and 430 px
items.evidence: Browser M/X explicitly checks 320, 360, 375, 390, 430, 760, 1024 and 1440 px.

items.requirement: No unwanted horizontal scrolling
items.evidence: scrollWidth <= innerWidth asserted at all required sizes, landscape and enlarged reflow.

items.requirement: Text, product cards and CTAs remain readable
items.evidence: Mobile screenshots reviewed; cards/text/buttons wrap and remain readable at the minimum width.

items.requirement: Tap targets are large enough and spaced correctly
items.evidence: Critical buttons/fields have 44 px height; adjacent smaller controls retain spacing. Lighthouse target-size audit and mobile interactions reviewed.

items.requirement: Mobile search, menu, filters and checkout are usable
items.evidence: Mobile projects exercise search submit, navigation/dropdown, filters and complete checkout.

items.requirement: Newsletter accepts valid email addresses
items.evidence: Valid email plus explicit consent records interest in SQLite; no email provider exists and UI says no marketing emails will be sent.

items.requirement: Invalid and duplicate submissions are handled
items.evidence: Browser native email validation and API invalid/duplicate checks; duplicate returns 409.

items.requirement: Success and failure messages are accurate
items.evidence: Success states say interest recorded only; failure/duplicate text comes from backend response.

items.requirement: Submission does not create duplicate requests
items.evidence: Synchronous submit lock and disabled loading state; rapid-click browser test asserts exactly one request.

items.requirement: Marketing consent is collected where required
items.evidence: Required newsletter checkbox and API consent=true validation; optional analytics has a separate opt-in.

items.requirement: MRP, selling price and discount calculation agree
items.evidence: MRP/current price in paise and rounded percentage match demo fixtures; client totals recomputed by API.

items.requirement: Coupon eligibility and expiry rules are enforced
items.evidence: Demo WELCOME10 eligibility/minimum/expiry tested, including expired fixture; real promotion policy unapproved.

items.requirement: Coupon cannot be redeemed beyond permitted limits
items.evidence: First-order-only server rule rejects reuse and post-order coupon attempts; cap ₹300 and maximum quantities checked.

items.requirement: Offer stacking follows configured business rules
items.evidence: Exactly one demo coupon permitted; stacked/invalid codes rejected, no implicit offer stacking.

items.requirement: Cart and checkout totals reflect valid discounts
items.evidence: Browser checkout quote and API exact arithmetic assertions include valid discount, shipping and included demo GST.

items.requirement: Shipping address and PIN code validation work
items.evidence: Required address fields and six-digit nonzero-leading PIN checked client/server; invalid PIN rejected.

items.requirement: Shipping charges and taxes calculate correctly
items.evidence: Demo inclusive 5% GST, ₹79 shipping and free-shipping threshold after discount checked. Merchant tax/shipping rules missing.

items.requirement: UPI, cards, wallets or COD work where enabled
items.evidence: UPI/card/wallet/COD simulations pass API tests; no payment gateway or approved COD fulfilment is connected. No real charge occurs.

items.requirement: Failed, cancelled and pending payments are handled safely
items.evidence: Failed/cancelled/pending simulation creates no order or stock change; pending can confirm; failed key cannot be reused.

items.requirement: One successful payment produces exactly one order
items.evidence: Concurrent/duplicate successful simulation creates one stored order and one stock deduction. Real gateway webhook/reconciliation still required.

items.requirement: No spelling mistakes or placeholder content
items.evidence: Business branding/address copy reviewed. Sample catalogue/prices/policies remain expressly labelled demo, so this cannot pass a live no-placeholder launch gate.

items.requirement: Product descriptions and specifications are accurate
items.evidence: Real product descriptions/specifications/photos have not been supplied or merchant-approved; current fixtures are visibly sample data.

items.requirement: Sizes, fabric and care information are available
items.evidence: Fabric, free-size length/blouse and care fields are present for each demo product; real accuracy requires merchant confirmation.

items.requirement: Promotional claims and ratings are substantiated
items.evidence: Google Maps 3.6/5 from 20 reviews and daily 10 AM–9 PM substantiated in BUSINESS_SOURCES.md; demo discount claims show conditions.

items.requirement: No dead links or outdated policy text
items.evidence: Internal route/policy/support controls work; directions use real listing. Policy dialogs truthfully identify unapproved demo terms.

items.requirement: Return policy and eligibility are clearly shown
items.evidence: Seven-day demo eligibility and non-returnable exclusions shown on product, policy and order pages; real policy unapproved.

items.requirement: Return request workflow works where supported
items.evidence: Owned confirmed demo order return can be requested once; expiry/nonreturnable/ownership API assertions pass.

items.requirement: Refund status reflects backend records accurately
items.evidence: Requests persist as requested; refund remains not issued. UI never invents a completed refund.

items.requirement: Non-returnable products are labelled correctly
items.evidence: Non-returnable demo item labelled on cards/details/order and excluded server-side.

items.requirement: Support and order-help links work
items.evidence: Order-help/account controls and Google directions links resolve. No unverified phone/contact channel is invented.

items.requirement: Search returns relevant products and suggestions
items.evidence: Search product suggestions and relevant collection results; product/collection routes preserve queries.

items.requirement: Misspellings and no-results searches are handled
items.evidence: Edit-distance-one typo test “silkk” finds four silk styles; empty searches show reset suggestions.

items.requirement: Page titles and meta descriptions are unique
items.evidence: Product/account/checkout/category titles and descriptions set on server and client; metadata escapes interpolated text.

items.requirement: Canonical URLs, sitemap and robots rules are correct
items.evidence: Deployed HTTPS origin missing. Demo stays noindex; robots disallows all without origin and sitemap returns explanatory 503. Live canonical/sitemap validation pending.

items.requirement: Product structured data uses valid real product details
items.evidence: Real product data missing, so no fabricated Product/Offer schema is emitted. Verified ClothingStore structured data is present.

items.requirement: Page view, product view and search events fire correctly
items.evidence: Consent-gated page_view/product_view/search events implemented; browser observes view events and API strips raw search text/PII.

items.requirement: Add-to-cart and begin-checkout events fire once
items.evidence: Browser rapid-click/checkout test observes one add/begin event per action; server event IDs deduplicate.

items.requirement: Purchase events fire only for confirmed orders
items.evidence: Browser observes one purchase only after confirmed owned order; API rejects nonexistent/foreign/unconfirmed orders.

items.requirement: Analytics never exposes passwords or payment secrets
items.evidence: API whitelists identifiers/counts/totals/routes and strips password/email/card/query fields; client test inspects payloads.

items.requirement: Consent preferences are respected
items.evidence: Essential-only sends no analytics; enabling emits events and disabling stops them. Newsletter consent is independent.

items.requirement: Login, registration and logout work
items.evidence: API login/register/logout and browser account/order journey checked; salt+scrypt password hash and HttpOnly cookie.

items.requirement: OTP or password reset works if supported
items.evidence: OTP and password reset are not offered in this demo; no deceptive reset/OTP controls. Choose real login/email provider before adding recovery.

items.requirement: Account sessions persist and expire correctly
items.evidence: Session survives reload and expires after seven days; API expiration fixture denies protected order access.

items.requirement: Wishlist add/remove and persistence work
items.evidence: Anonymous wishlist survives reload; account wishlist persists server-side and is isolated between users.

items.requirement: Users cannot access another customer's account or orders
items.evidence: Server authorisation prevents reading/returning another customer’s order and segregates wishlists; not a client-only guard.

items.requirement: Desktop screenshots match approved reference layouts
items.evidence: Current desktop captures exist, but no approved reference screenshot/baseline was supplied; cannot assert a reference match.

items.requirement: Mobile screenshots match approved reference layouts
items.evidence: Current mobile captures exist, but no approved reference screenshot/baseline was supplied; cannot assert a reference match.

items.requirement: No accidental typography or spacing regressions
items.evidence: Current typography/spacing reviewed with screenshots and viewport tests; approved regression baseline remains unavailable.

items.requirement: All modal, error, hover and empty states are reviewed
items.evidence: Policy/privacy/empty bag/wishlist/zoom/form/checkout states checked with axe; API/image errors and busy/disabled states reviewed.

items.requirement: Image crops and banners remain consistent after changes
items.evidence: Current hero/gallery crops reviewed at required sizes; future approved-baseline comparison remains pending.

items.requirement: Chrome and Edge desktop flows work
items.evidence: System Chromium desktop passes. Actual branded Chrome and Microsoft Edge binaries were not installed/tested.

items.requirement: Firefox desktop flows work
items.evidence: Playwright Firefox desktop suite passes after supported runner permissions resolved its user-namespace crash.

items.requirement: Safari on iOS works
items.evidence: Playwright WebKit iPhone 13 emulation passes; this is not physical Safari/iOS verification.

items.requirement: Chrome on Android works
items.evidence: Chromium Pixel 7 emulation passes; physical Android Chrome verification remains outstanding.

items.requirement: Touch, mouse, keyboard and browser back work
items.evidence: Mouse clicks, mobile/touch-style controls, pointer swipe, keyboard and back/forward checked in available engine projects.

items.requirement: Portrait and landscape layouts work
items.evidence: Required portrait widths and 844×390 landscape checked for overflow and visible controls.

items.requirement: Zoom at 200% does not hide essential functions
items.evidence: 200% CSS zoom/reflow and enlarged text checks keep checkout usable. Actual browser toolbar zoom/physical-device accessibility review remains pending.

items.requirement: Long names and translated text do not overflow
items.evidence: Injected long Hindi/English product and escaped account names at 320 px remain inside viewport; no HTML execution.

items.requirement: Slow or interrupted network requests recover gracefully
items.evidence: Aborted catalog/image requests expose recoverable state and retry restores content; delayed catalog shows loading skeleton.

items.requirement: Refresh during cart or checkout does not corrupt state
items.evidence: Bag reload and checkout refresh preserve valid lines and checkout idempotency key; malformed storage resets safely.

items.requirement: HTTPS is enforced and no mixed content loads
items.evidence: Production-mode tests verify HTTP→HTTPS redirect, Secure session cookie and HSTS behind configured trusted proxy. Actual HTTPS deployment/mixed-content crawl pending.

items.requirement: Sensitive API keys are not exposed in frontend bundles
items.evidence: No provider secrets were configured or embedded; built client is static app code, with private server/DB/env excluded. /server is denied.

items.requirement: Authentication and authorisation are enforced server-side
items.evidence: Auth, ownership, stock/price/coupon and checkout eligibility enforced in API with expired-session/foreign-order tests.

items.requirement: Forms and APIs resist common injection and XSS attacks
items.evidence: Parameterized SQLite, body limits, CSRF/origin/rate controls and hashed inline script CSP; SQL injection and rendered XSS-name tests pass.

items.requirement: Payments, personal data and logs follow applicable privacy rules
items.evidence: Demo has no payment credentials and analytics strips PII; live privacy retention/deletion/contact, payment processor obligations and merchant policy approval remain unresolved.

items.requirement: All critical shopping journeys pass end to end
items.evidence: All critical DEMO journeys pass (account→product→checkout→order→return); real buying/email/refund journeys are externally blocked.

items.requirement: No open P0 or P1 defects remain
items.evidence: Demo defects found in this task were fixed. Live checkout/catalog/policies/deployment/device gates remain release blockers, so no live zero-P0/P1 claim.

items.requirement: No broken critical links or missing product assets
items.evidence: Local smoke routes/assets pass and every visible photo loads; no broken critical demo internal routes/assets found.

items.requirement: Monitoring, backups and rollback procedures are ready
items.evidence: Health/smoke and documented monitoring/rollback exist; fixture backup/restore integrity, non-overwrite and checksum refusal pass. Hosted alerts/offsite backups/rollback not provisioned.

items.requirement: Production smoke tests pass after deployment
items.evidence: GitHub URL is not a deployment URL. Local production-build smoke passes; post-deployment smoke cannot run without the real hosted origin.
